stories.title: Supermicro fires several employees following investigation into $2.5 billion China AI chip smuggling — claims that senior management had no knowledge of illicit transactions

sources.title: Supermicro fires several employees following investigation into $2.5 billion China AI chip smuggling — claims that senior management had no knowledge of illicit transactions
sources.title_en: Supermicro fires several employees following investigation into $2.5 billion China AI chip smuggling — claims that senior management had no knowledge of illicit transactions
sources.title_original: Supermicro fires several employees following investigation into $2.5 billion China AI chip smuggling — claims that senior management had no knowledge of illicit transactions
sources.summary: An independent investigation on Supermicro clears senior management from any wrong-doing and also says that its financial statements were still reliable, despite the alleged diversion of its restricted products. Nevertheless, some of its employees from sales, technical support, and business development departments were fired for failing to 'follow Company policies or the Company’s code of conduct.'
sources.summary_zh: 对超微的一项独立调查表明，高级管理层没有任何不当行为，并表示，尽管其受限制产品涉嫌被转移，但其财务报表仍然可靠。然而，销售、技术支持和业务开发部门的一些员工因未能“遵守公司政策或公司行为准则”而被解雇。

stories.title: World's largest open library calls for volunteers to scan and preserve physical books as AI companies buy, scan, and destroy them — Anna's Archive says ‘time is running out’ as ‘knowledge is permanently monopolized on private servers’

sources.title: World's largest open library calls for volunteers to scan and preserve physical books as AI companies buy, scan, and destroy them — Anna's Archive says ‘time is running out’ as ‘knowledge is permanently monopolized on private servers’
sources.title_en: World's largest open library calls for volunteers to scan and preserve physical books as AI companies buy, scan, and destroy them — Anna's Archive says ‘time is running out’ as ‘knowledge is permanently monopolized on private servers’
sources.title_original: World's largest open library calls for volunteers to scan and preserve physical books as AI companies buy, scan, and destroy them — Anna's Archive says ‘time is running out’ as ‘knowledge is permanently monopolized on private servers’
sources.summary: A volunteer for Anna's Archive is calling for volunteers to scan and upload books to the shadow library to help preserve human knowledge for the public. The move comes as more AI companies buy, scan, and destroy books to feed to AI models, which is easier and faster than scanning the written works in a non-destructive manner.
sources.summary_zh: 安娜档案馆的一名志愿者正在呼吁志愿者扫描书籍并将其上传到影子图书馆，以帮助为公众保存人类知识。随着越来越多的人工智能公司购买、扫描和销毁书籍以供人工智能模型使用，这比以非破坏性方式扫描书面作品更容易、更快捷。

stories.title: LG Display introduces new OLED deposition technique that uses lithography instead of metal masks — "FLiPP" photolithography delivers 1.6x brightness and 2.4x longer lifespan

sources.title: LG Display introduces new OLED deposition technique that uses lithography instead of metal masks — "FLiPP" photolithography delivers 1.6x brightness and 2.4x longer lifespan
sources.title_en: LG Display introduces new OLED deposition technique that uses lithography instead of metal masks — "FLiPP" photolithography delivers 1.6x brightness and 2.4x longer lifespan
sources.title_original: LG Display introduces new OLED deposition technique that uses lithography instead of metal masks — "FLiPP" photolithography delivers 1.6x brightness and 2.4x longer lifespan
sources.summary: OLED displays have long been manufacturer using a metal mask for deposition that wastes material, is expensive, and can sag under its own weight. LG Display's FLiPP solves this by using photolithography instead, relying on photomasks and photoresist layers to lock in the RGB subpixels.
sources.summary_zh: OLED显示器制造商长期以来一直使用金属掩模进行沉积，这种方法浪费材料，价格昂贵，并且会因自重而下垂。 LG Display 的 FLiPP 通过使用光刻技术解决了这个问题，依靠光掩模和光刻胶层来锁定 RGB 子像素。
